failureMessage: every PR here is opened under missingbulb, the same account a review request would name, and GitHub always rejects requesting review from a PR's own author

guardToolCalls.what: a {tool} call requesting review from "missingbulb", the PR's own author
guardToolCalls.fix: drop missingbulb from reviewers — assigning them, or leaving reviewers empty, is what a review request was reaching for

failureMessage: list_workflow_runs with no perPage has overflowed the tool-result limit against this repo's actions history (90,202 characters, re-measured 2026-09-24) every time it's been tried, at perPage values down to 1

guardToolCalls.what: a {tool} call for list_workflow_runs with no `perPage`
guardToolCalls.fix: pass `perPage` (e.g. 30) alongside `method: "list_workflow_runs"` — an explicit value keeps the response inside the tool-result limit

failureMessage: the gh CLI is not installed in this environment, so a command invoking it always fails; the GitHub MCP tools are how a session reaches GitHub here

guardToolCalls.what: a Bash call invoking `{cmd}` — the gh CLI is not installed here
guardToolCalls.fix: use the matching mcp__github__* tool instead of the gh CLI
